elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The USD 5,000,000 obligation is triggered only where TrueLink processes “Credit Data or Client Content.” The rendered language does not establish that these terms include all Customer Data, and absence of Customer Data processing is not demonstrable.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must provide certificates of insurance on request.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required professional liability (errors and omissions) limit is USD 2,000,000, exceeding the USD 1,000,000 fallback.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Cyber and privacy coverage is not required unconditionally; it applies only where TrueLink processes Credit Data or Client Content.
